The First Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo To Be Held On March 21 & 22 -Update

On the weekend of the Spring Equinox, March 21 & 22, at the Civic Auditorium, we will be hosting the first Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo. Our purpose is to bring together commerce and education for the promotion of the vast rediscovered potential of hemp.

The Expo will connect manufacturers and retailers with agriculture to help make significant inroads into growing and processing hemp fiber, seed, and pulp for a multitude of uses. Among these uses are paper, clothing, cosmetics, food and nutrition, medicine, carpeting, building materials, hardware items, industrial lubricants, paints, biomass fuel, and the paradoxical "biodegradeable plastics."

 

70 vendors are filling 56 booths, which will provide definitive examples of the many ways hemp is making its well-deserved comeback for pacesetting industries into the next century. This is an opportunity to meet firsthand the people who have established hemp businesses, from manufacturing to retail, and to sample and learn about their products.

Scheduled during the event are speakers and panels who will address a wide range of themes relevant to hemp’s new promise. Panel discussions will include: Industrial Hemp and the Global Economy, Hemp and the Media, Food and Nutrition, Cosmetics, Women’s Perspective in Hemp Business, Fiber Production, Paper Making, Fashion, Therapeutic Applications, Legislative Goals, History of Hemp, and Hemp Product Development.

The lineup of speakers, some of whom are well-known writers on hemp, includes Chris Conrad, Jack Herer, Agi Orsi, Julie Lewis, Candi Penn, Mari Kane, John Stahl, John Dvorak, Peter Brady, Robert Nelson, Dave Seber, Dave West, and ex-Senator Lloyd Casey. Among them will be representatives from Hemp World, Hemp Magazine, Hemp Times, and the Hemp Industries Association (HIA).

Fifteen hours of vidoes will play throughout the weekend, featuring "The Hemp Revolution," and other classic and new films. Educational and historical exhibits will be displayed in the hallways, including up-to-date information on agricultural methods of hemp growing and harvesting. On display will be a miniature hemp village and a hemp house. Conference rooms will be scheduled for meetings for attendees and exhibitors.

One of the treats of the Expo will be the opportunity to sample a host of hemp foods that are now becoming available. Hemp seed, flour, and oil are highly nutritious. Enjoy hemp pizza, burgers, humus, pesto, salad dressing, pre-mixes, cookies, pretzels, smoothies, and hemp beer and wine.

Many familiar names in hemp cosmetic manufacturing will be present to display their products. Also, a fashion show will feature a wide range of both men’s and women’s clothing. Music will provide ambience throughout the event, in addition to the big Saturday night networking party featuring the live, original sounds of local Santa Cruz musicians.

Many raffle prizes will be offered by sponsors and vendors.

This event is on the cutting edge of the merging of environmentalism and commerce. Hemp can lead the way toward the new paradigm of environmental and economic sustainability. Join us and share with us this Vision into the 21st century.
